title: be동사 과거 부정문·의문문 (wasn't / Were you ~?)
goal: wasn't / weren't로 '~이 아니었어요, ~에 없었어요'라고 말하고, Was / Were로 지난 일을 물어보고 대답할 수 있어요.

points.title: 부정문: was / were + not
points.body: '~이 아니었어요', '~에 없었어요'는 was / were 뒤에 not을 붙여요. 줄이면 was not = wasn't, were not = weren't예요.

points.title: 누가 wasn't, 누가 weren't?
points.body: I, he, she, it은 wasn't, we, you, they는 weren't를 써요. 앞 유닛의 was / were와 짝이 똑같아요.

points.title: 의문문: was / were를 맨 앞으로
points.body: '~이었어요?', '~에 있었어요?'는 was / were를 주어 앞으로 보내요. You were busy. → Were you busy? / Tom was at his desk. → Was Tom at his desk?

points.title: 짧게 대답하기
points.body: Yes, I was. / No, I wasn't.처럼 was / were로 짧게 대답해요. Were you ~?로 물으면 나에 대한 질문이니까 I was / I wasn't로 대답해요.

points.title: 꼭 Yes / No만 하지 않아도 돼요
points.body: 실제 대화에서는 "Not really.(별로요.)"처럼 부드럽게 대답하기도 해요.

formula: I / He / She / It + was not (= wasn't) + ...
We / You / They + were not (= weren't) + ...

mistakes.why: 한국어는 '안'이 앞에 오지만, 영어는 not이 was / were 뒤에 와요.
you는 한 명이어도 항상 were예요. 질문에서도 Were you ~?
질문은 Were you였지만, 대답의 주어는 I니까 was로 바꿔요.

examples.en: I was not good at math in high school.
examples.ko: 나는 고등학교 때 수학을 잘 못했어요.

examples.en: My vacation was fun, but it wasn't very long.
Melanie and I weren't friends a year ago. Now we're best friends.
examples.ko: Melanie와 나는 1년 전에는 친구가 아니었어요. 지금은 가장 친한 친구예요.

examples.en: "You weren't at the office last week." "I was on a business trip."
Was Tom at his desk this morning?
"Were you at the mall last night?" "Yes, I was."

quiz.sentence: I ___ at work yesterday. It was my day off.
___ you at the beach last weekend?

quiz.why: the bus는 하나니까 Was. yesterday morning은 과거예요.
Was로 물으면 wasn't로 대답해요. it은 wasn't.
you는 were. 질문이니까 Were를 맨 앞에.

quiz.answer: We weren't friends a year ago.
choices: We weren't friends a year ago.
We wasn't friends a year ago.
We aren't friends a year ago.
We not were friends a year ago.
quiz.why: We의 과거 부정은 weren't. not은 were 뒤에 와요.

quiz.answer: Was Tom at his desk this morning?
choices: Was Tom at his desk this morning?
Were Tom at his desk this morning?
Did Tom at his desk this morning?
Was Tom his desk this morning?
quiz.why: Tom은 한 명이니까 Was. '~에 있었다'는 at + 장소.

choices: The hotel not was very nice.
quiz.why: the hotel은 하나니까 wasn't. not very nice = 별로 좋지 않은.

quiz.prompt: "Were you at the mall last night?"에 맞는 대답을 고르세요.
quiz.why: 나에 대한 질문이니까 주어는 I, 그래서 was.

quiz.answer: My parents weren't in Korea last month.
choices: My parents weren't in Korea last month.
My parents wasn't in Korea last month.
My parents didn't in Korea last month.
My parents not were in Korea last month.

quiz.answer: Was it cold in Melbourne yesterday?
choices: Was it cold in Melbourne yesterday?
Were it cold in Melbourne yesterday?
Is it cold in Melbourne yesterday?
Was cold it in Melbourne yesterday?
quiz.why: it은 was. 질문은 Was + it + cold 순서.
